purpose: Phase-7B vascular evidence records. The frozen package contains NO direct tumour-vasculature dataset (no vessel count, blood flow, pO2, vascular diameter, or perfusion rate for this context). Every record is qualitative (general tumour-vasculature biology) with citation NOT_REPORTED; vascular relationships are LABELLED PREDICTIONS, never experimental facts.

va_b16bl6_vasculature.citation: NOT_REPORTED (melanoma tumour vasculature is typically abnormal - hypervascular but immature/chaotic and leaky; general tumour biology applied predictively)

va_b16bl6_perfusion.citation: NOT_REPORTED (tumour vessels are often poorly perfused despite high density, limiting drug delivery and oxygen supply; general tumour biology applied predictively)
supports: poor perfusion despite high vessel density lowers delivery + oxygen supply (qualitative)
va_b16bl6_perfusion.note: Passive/architecture modifier only; no vascular signalling.

va_human_vasculature.citation: NOT_REPORTED (human skin/tumour vasculature predicted with own distinct states; predictive, not validated)
supports: moderately vascularized, developing human vessels (qualitative, predictive)

integrity_rules.no_fabricated_quantities: No blood flow / vessel count / pO2 / vascular diameter / perfusion rate is stated.
integrity_rules.prediction_never_experimental: Vascular relationships are labelled predictions; none is presented as experimental (there is no experimental vascular tier).
integrity_rules.not_reported_stays: Absent vascular data stays NOT_REPORTED; it is never upgraded to a measurement.
integrity_rules.no_silent_species_transfer: Species are isolated; a cross-species use requires an explicit CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION.
